items.title: Control: LLM on the target review only (paper's 'LLM' row)
items.detail: 73.29 AUROC / 30.54 AUPRC on the review alone. Graph context adds +1.69 AUROC / +1.83 AUPRC (Holm p 0.011), vs +5.54 / +7.60 in the paper: our LLM baseline is much stronger than the paper's. results/controls/controls.md Added to the DGP experiment log as E15 (docx rebuilt).

items.title: FLAG controls with per-node scores (dual raw text, baseline_z, MLP)
items.detail: 1,900 runs, 0 failed; FLAG commit 4f9d994 (branch flag-controls). Re-runs identical to results/main (CPU-stored). LLM text alone (flag - text_dual): Reddit +0.62 AUC, Instagram -0.94 (Holm p<0.05); architecture alone ~0. 42.4% of Instagram subgraphs have LLM text (the 9.1% counts node slots); there it costs -2.18 AUC. Per-node scores (~230 MB) are outside git: include results/controls/*/*/scores in the HF backup.

items.title: One statistics standard (seed-level paired t + Holm) for E2-E14
items.detail: scripts/stats_standard.py: 36 comparisons (E16 YelpChi, E17 w/o MDK added), 108 seed-level paired t-tests, Holm per experiment and global. No prompt-side effect (E2, E8, E12) survives; E11 3/15, E13 1/15, E14 3/9, E15 7/9, E16 2/3, E17 0/3. results/stats/all_comparisons.md; README §23; report §8. Commit a07aa64.

items.title: DGP on YelpChi: build graph, check edge count against Table 1, then 5 seeds
items.detail: DGP 61.76 / 78.38 / 31.05 (paper 69.07 / 84.28 / 48.87); MLP 63.64 / 74.66 / 33.67 (paper 62.09 / 75.00 / 32.24). DGP - MLP: AUROC +3.72 (5/5, Holm p 0.004), AUPRC -2.62 (0/5, Holm p 0.039). Early stopping on val loss keeps epoch 1-3 while val AUROC peaks at the last epoch in every seed: a hyperparameter-search item. results/controls/yelpchi.md, README §11, E16.

items.title: Ablation: w/o MDK (random neighbours)
items.detail: R0 with mdk: false (M=4 random neighbours, controls/A1_without_mdk.yaml), 5 seeds, training 14:42-20:11Z. noMDK 65.28 / 74.61 / 32.51 vs R0 64.74 / 74.97 / 32.37 (Macro-F1 / AUROC / AUPRC). R0 - noMDK: -0.53 / +0.36 / -0.14, none significant (bootstrap CIs include 0): MDK adds nothing measurable; the paper reports a decline. results/controls/nomdk.md; README §14; report E17 card.

items.title: Fourth cell: Qwen text + Gemma classifier
items.detail: gs_QG0 = dr_R0's cached Qwen text (all 35,747 node + 119,829 metapath summaries reused) + Gemma-2-9B-it classifier (11c9b309). Prompts identical to R0's except 92 long target reviews cut at 1,024 Gemma tokens (as in G0). One training lane. Seed 0 done 22:03Z in 1.64 h (4 epochs, kept epoch 2): Macro-F1 65.29 / AUROC 76.08 / AUPRC 33.55 (R0 seed 0: 64.78 / 75.13 / 32.78; G0 seed 0: 63.63 / 76.21 / 33.96). Seed 1 started 22:04Z; all five expected about 04:30Z. Then scripts/qg0_analysis.py: 2x2 writer x classifier with interaction (E18).
